biography_english:
A Xenobian from the city of Peshaval in Charlom. She is sister to Canopus. A songstress of renown, her voice is said to soothe the hearts of all who hear it.
  People have flocked to see her since she came to Omish. However, death now seems to stalk the townspeople at every turn, and some believe her to be the accursed Wicce Sirene.
biography_spanish:
Xenobiana de la ciudad de Peshaval en Charlom. Hermana de Canopus. Cantante de renombre, su voz calma el corazon de todos los que la escuchan.               
  La gente acude a verla desde que llego a Omish. Sin embargo, la muerte acecha a los vecinos a cada paso, y algunos creen que es la maldita Wicce Sirene.

biography_english:
A Xenobian from the city of Peshaval in Charlom. She is sister to Canopus. A songstress of renown, her voice is said to soothe the hearts of all who hear it. Winged womenfolk are seldom seen in public, but Iuria seems fond of attention.
  She was possessed by Sirene when waylaid by pirates en route to Valeria to find her brother Canopus. She brought death upon Omish with her songs, but the curse was broken by {hero}. Returning to her old self, she joined the Order of {order}.

Xenobiana de la ciudad de Peshaval en Charlom. Hermana de Canopus. Cantante de renombre, su voz calma el corazon de todos los que la escuchan. Las mujeres aladas rara vez se ven en publico, pero Iuria busca atencion.                    
  Fue poseida por Sirene cuando piratas la interceptaron en ruta a Valeria para hallar a su hermano Canopus. Trajo la muerte a Omish con sus cantos, pero {hero} rompio la maldicion. Al volver a ser ella, se unio a la Orden de {order}.

biography_english: A Galgastani who once served her clan in battle. Together with her mother, Cassandra, and sister, Moldova, she practices necromancy under the Necromancer Nybeth, believing that reviving the flesh of the dead by calling their souls back to the transient world serves to dispel their feelings of regret.

biography_english:

Together with her mother, Cassandra, and sister, Moldova, she practiced necromancy under the Necromancer Nybeth, believing that reviving the flesh of the dead by calling their souls back to the transient world would serve to dispel their feelings of regret.
  Cressida continued her work after the downfall of the Kingdom of Galgastan, but was later slain by the Resistance.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once served her clan in battle. She is the daughter of the Necromancer Nybeth. Together with mother, Cassandra, and sister, Moldova, she practiced necromancy under her father.
  At the fall of the Kingdom of Galgastan she fled to Golyat. After castigating Nybeth for the failures of his necromancy, he almost took her life. {hero} went to her aid, but she could not forgive him for the deaths of her mother and sister, and so they parted ways.
biography_spanish:
Galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Es hija del Nigromante Nybeth. Junto a su madre, Cassandra, y su hermana, Moldova, practico nigromancia bajo su padre.                              
  Al caer el Reino de Galgastan huyo a Golyat. Tras reprender a Nybeth por los fallos de su nigromancia, casi le quito la vida. {hero} acudio en su ayuda, pero ella no pudo perdonarlo por las muertes de su madre y hermana, asi que tomaron caminos separados.

biography_english:
